title: DoltLite Brings Git-Style Version Control to a SQLite Fork
dek: DoltHub has announced DoltLite, a SQLite fork positioned around Git-style version control. The beta’s most notable development detail: its creators say it was built through roughly 2,000 agent-generated pull requests.
socialCaption: DoltHub has announced DoltLite, a SQLite fork with Git-style version control, in beta. Its other notable claim: roughly 2,000 agent-generated pull requests helped build it. The key question now is whether the versioning model and the agent-assisted process hold up under real-world evaluation.
